en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to me by Ahmad b. Muhammad from Sa’d b. Abdillah from Muhammad b. Isa from al-Hassan b. Ali b. Fadhal from Ghalib b. Uthman from Shu’aib from a man from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
One who controls himself at the time of fear and anger, Allah will prohibit fire for his body.”
